<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/v1/models"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

</MethodEndpoint>



Derived from the owning AIGateway's `spec.routes[].match.model`,
then filtered to the caller's effective model access as the
Directory decides it — so this surface and the data-plane
GET /v1/models intercept always agree about what the caller
may call. Deduplicated and sorted by model id, OpenAI-shaped
(`object:"list"`, `data[]`) to match that intercept.

`?scope=all` returns the complete configured catalog instead,
unfiltered, for an Admin authoring a Model Set — who must be
able to grant models their own access does not include. It
requires the deployment's admin role.
